transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I’m here because everybody keeps acting like I’m just imagining it. But I know my wife’s relative came into this house to get at me. I mean, my tools don’t move themselves. And my fishing plans don't get spoiled by accident every single weekend. After all these months, I can see it plain as day... he’s been trying to take over my place and push me out.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds when there was no one around to make them?

No, I haven't. I don't hear voices or... or sounds that aren't there. I'm not making things up in my head, if that's what you mean. It's just what I actually see happening with my own eyes, like I said. But no, no voices.

Do I... have trouble trusting other people? No, not at all. I mean, I get along fine with the guys at work. I do assembly work, and you know, you have to trust the guys on your shift to do their part. I don't have any issues with my friends or the neighbors, either. 

I'm not walking around thinking everyone in the world is out to get me, if that's what you're asking. It's really just him. It's just this one specific guy, because I can actually see what he's doing to my house and my things. With everybody else, I'm perfectly fine.
Have you had any major physical illnesses, head injuries, or neurological conditions recently?
No, nothing like that. I haven't been sick, no head injuries... my health is perfectly fine. I just go to work and do my job, you know? Physically, there's absolutely nothing wrong with me.
